hooks.command: H=$(ls -t docs/revisiones/HANDOFF_*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$H" ] && echo "Handoff mas reciente del proyecto: $H. Si la tarea continua trabajo previo (informes, polos, cafecito, mercados), leerlo antes de empezar." || true

command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f .graphify/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":".graphify/graph.json exists. Consider `graphify query \"<question>\"` before grepping raw source files (not needed for docs/outputs)."}}'   || true ;; esac

command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.astro','.vue','.svelte','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh');vals=[str(t.get('file_path') or ''),str(t.get('pattern') or ''),str(t.get('path') or '')];j=' '.join(vals).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');tails=[('.'+x.rsplit('.',1)[-1]) for v in vals if v for x in [v.lower().replace(chr(92),'/').rsplit('/',1)[-1]] if '.' in x];sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify' not in j and any(tl in exts for tl in tails) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f .graphify/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":".graphify/graph.json exists. Consider `graphify query \"<question>\"`, `graphify explain \"<concept>\"` or `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"` to orient before reading source files."}}'; fi || true
